name: US–China / Taiwan
value: G7 warns on China east of Taiwan; APEC next
summary: G7 ministers said on 10 Nov China's activity east of Taiwan threatens stability; area-denial drills go on
state: G7 foreign ministers meeting in Paris said in a declaration published on 10 Nov that China's activity east of Taiwan threatens regional stability and the safety of shipping (Taipei Times, 12 Nov). Taiwan's defence minister Wellington Koo said on 10 Nov that China is running area-denial drills in the Western Pacific with a carrier group (ThePrint). No blockade, quarantine, clash or severed channel was found as of 12 Nov, with Presidents Trump and Xi expected at APEC in Shenzhen.
for_you: Shipping and flights near Taiwan can face disruption at short notice. UK travellers should check FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: Large-scale PLA naval activity around Taiwan (Watch); no blockade, quarantine or clash (Alert line)

sources.title: Taipei Times — G7 foreign ministers say China's actions east of Taiwan threaten stability
ThePrint — Taiwan says China is conducting area-denial drills in Western Pacific

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
